I've tested this via deployment, and the functionality seems to work.  Will test further on local branch.

But... Could we please move "Additional data" above the "Permission" block, so it's beneath "Terminology"?  Otherwise I worry that it could slip off the bottom of the page, and be missed.

sure @IanMayo

Hello @lebaphi ,
I've had a play in the branch.

The `Participations` now show valid fields (see below). But, the fields aren't editable.  If you don't have chance to work on it, I'll come back & look tomorrow.  I (strongly) suspect part of the solution is casting the `Participant` to `ParticipantCollab`.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/148430329-d59ca0ed-acf1-4cb7-8475-e6ac3895d3be.png)

> #1278

Hi @IanMayo , I keep the old participant but add more fields into it, you can see the file `setting-channels/helpers/generateRowItems.ts`, code line from 47 to 86.
So I should keep the old `Participant` and to create a new interface like `ParticipantCollab` with new fields.

Hello @lebaphi 

_One day_ we will get rid of `Participant` - and use `ParticipantCore` and its child interfaces.  For now we check `isCollab` and use the `ParticipantCollab` interface when we know it's valid:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/148523671-9fd837c4-5410-4989-b28c-17d4bf1a517d.png)

Note: I _think_ we need to refactor the editor page for `Channels` tab.  I _think_ we need a separate instance for each type of channel.   That will produce much cleaner code - the same class won't have to handle each different type of channel.  

Then it will be easy/tidy for the channel-type to have its own properties at the top, and different `Participant` columns for different channel types. Unique TypeScript interfaces for the `Channel` and `Participant` for this channel-type will keep the code easy to maintain/understand (such as `ChannelCollab` that contains a list of `ParticipantCollab`).

What do you think?

(But, let's get this version working first, anyway 🤣 )

The new controls in the `Participant` row appear to be either locked, or the handler isn't updating state correctly:

issues.title: Implement new admin controls for Collab Editing
issues.body:
Implement the UI shown at the end of the thread in #1198 

This is the creation of a new admin page, used to edit Collaborative Editing channels.

The `Channels` admin page will have these changes:
* [x] Change the `Add channel` button to just have `Collab' Editing` and `Mapping`
* [x] On `Collab' Editing`, open new `CollaborativeEditing` page
* [x] New page will allow creation/edit of a new `ChannelCollab` object
* [x] UI for object contained in #1198 
* [x] Instead of existing `Participant` editor table, it will edit instances of `ParticipantCollab`.
